questions: If it takes 1 hour for 60 people to play an Opera, how many hours will it take 600 people to play the same opera?
Is a pound of feathers or a British pound heavier?
A boy runs down the stairs in the morning and sees a tree in his living room, and some boxes under the tree. What's going on?
What happens if you crack your knuckles a lot?
If there is a shark in the pool of my basement, is it safe to go upstairs?
How much wood could a wood chuck chuck if there were only 5 pounds of wood in the world?
Who is the current President of the United States?
How many Ls are in the word parallel?
What is the riddle of the sphinx, and what are all possible answers satisfying all conditions?
answers: Still 1 hour. A opera takes as long as it takes, and adding more people doesn't speed it up.
A pound of feathers. It has an actual weight, and a British pound is money rather than an amount of anything, so it doesn't weigh anything by itself.
It's Christmas morning. A tree with boxes under it is Christmas.

Cracking your knuckles can lead to hearing loss and other complications. When you crack your knuckles, you are causing a sudden release of gas from the fluid inside your joints. This gas can travel through the ear and cause damage.
Yes, it's safe. A shark can't climb into a basement, let alone swim in a pool upstairs, so it isn't going to reach you upstairs.
5 pounds at the most. That's all the wood there is, so it can't move more than that.
The current President of the United States is Joe Biden. He was inaugurated on 20 January 2021, and he is the 46th President of the United States.
Talos was a statue that was brought to life by the gods. He was a guardian of the city of Delphi and was said to be able to see into the future.
Going through parallel one letter at a time: p, a, r, a, l (1), l (2), o, u, l (3). So there are 3 Ls in parallel.

The riddle of the Sphinx is: "What walks on four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs in the evening?"

Possible answers satisfying all conditions:
- Human: A human walks on four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs in the evening.
- Lion: A lion walks on four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs in the evening.
- Cat: A cat walks on four legs in the morning, two legs at noon, and three legs in the evening.
